item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 02/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry continental airstream, the weather will become fine over southern China in the next few days with temperatures rising gradually.

Date/Month: 03/04 (Sunday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore later.
Weather: Cool in the morning. Mainly fine and dry during the day.
Temp range: 14 - 21 C
R.H. range: 50 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 04/04 (Monday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Fine and dry.
Temp range: 16 - 23 C
R.H. range: 50 - 75 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 05/04 (Tuesday)
Wind: East to northeast force 3 to 4, force 5 at first.
Weather: Fine and dry.
Temp range: 17 - 25 C
R.H. range: 50 - 75 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 06/04 (Wednesday)
Wind: East to northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 19 - 26 C
R.H. range: 55 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 07/04 (Thursday)
Wind: East to northeast force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly fine. Hot and dry during the day.
Temp range: 20 - 28 C
R.H. range: 55 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 08/04 (Friday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4, force 5 offshore later.
Weather: Fine. Hot and dry during the day.
Temp range: 21 - 28 C
R.H. range: 50 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 09/04 (Saturday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4, force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Fine. Hot and dry during the day.
Temp range: 21 - 28 C
R.H. range: 50 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 10/04 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 21 - 27 C
R.H. range: 55 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 11/04 (Monday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4.
Weather: Sunny periods. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 22 - 27 C
R.H. range: 55 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low

Sea surface temperature at 2 P.M. 02/04/2022 at North Point was 20 degrees C.
Soil temperatures at 7 A.M. 02/04/2022 at Hong Kong Observatory :
0.5 M below surface was 23.2 degrees C
1.0 M below surface was 23.7 degrees C
